A CRH2A head made exclusively for Simurail physics trains.
Do not use with Create's standard train system. This block is hidden when Simurail is not installed.
block.hexie.crh2a_head.tooltip.summary: A CRH2A head with an editable vehicle number.
block.hexie.crh2a_head.tooltip.behaviour: Right-click the head to edit its vehicle number.
block.hexie.crh2a_carport_mid_antenna.to: A CRH2A center roof with selectable variants.
Right-click to cycle between antenna 1, antenna 2, high-voltage cables, and an empty roof.
block.hexie.crh2a_endface.tooltip.summar: A CRH2A end face with a coupler and gangway.
block.hexie.crh2a_endface.tooltip.behavi: Right-click to cycle between an inclined connector, a horizontal connector with cables, a horizontal connector without cables, and the original end face.
A rescue adapter that connects Shibata couplers to Janney couplers.
block.hexie.crh2a_passenger_door.tooltip: A CRH2A passenger door with optional side frames.
Tap right-click to show or hide the side frames.
block.hexie.crh2a_electronic_signage.too: Attaches to carriage panels and alternates between the train number and train name.
Hold the display and right-click a carriage panel with or without windows to attach it.
Use a Brush (white) to remove the display. Right-click with an empty hand to reverse its direction.
block.hexie.crh2a_driving_console.toolti: Currently decorative, with no driving functionality.
block.hexie.crh2a_driver_seat.tooltip.su: A driver seat for the CRH2A standardized driving console.
block.hexie.crh2a_driver_seat.tooltip.be: Automatically turns 180 degrees to face the correct driving direction.
block.hexie.crh2a_cab_seat.tooltip.summa: A driver seat for the CRH2A non-standardized driving console.
block.hexie.crh2a_cab_seat.tooltip.behav: Automatically turns 180 degrees to face the correct driving direction.
block.hexie.crh2a_carriage_number_displa: A CRH2A display with an editable carriage number.
Hold the display and right-click a carriage panel with or without windows to attach it.
Right-click the display to edit the carriage number it shows.
Use a Brush (white) to remove the display. Right-click with an empty hand to reverse its direction.
block.hexie.crh2a_endface: CRH2A End Face with Coupler and Gangway
